anomalies.observed: In the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block on sheet 1 (PCB.kicad_sch) the two hierarchical labels NET0010 and NET0017 are both attached to one and the same node: that node is the left-hand terminal of R10 (1 kΩ) and it also carries C21 (22 nF) to GND. R10's other terminal goes to A1 pin 1 (BTN, the touch electrode). So PB5 and PB7 are shorted together, and the 22 nF sampling capacitor sits on the electrode-drive node instead of on its own IO.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification the two TSC group-2 IOs are separate nets: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN" (the touch electrode)' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group'. PB5 must reach the electrode through the 1 kΩ series resistor alone, and PB7 must carry only the 22 nF capacitor to GND; the two nets must never be joined.

evidence.quote: TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN" (the touch electrode)
TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group
Capacitive Touch Button (TSC) block, sheet 1: labels NET0010 and NET0017 on the same wire feeding R10 1k and C21 22n; R10 goes to A1 pin 1 (BTN), C21 goes to GND

anomalies.impact: PB5 and PB7 are shorted and the 22 nF sampling capacitor is placed directly on the electrode node. The STM32 TSC group-2 acquisition is broken (the sampling capacitor no longer sits on the sampling IO and the two IOs drive each other), so the capacitive touch button will not detect touches.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains one likely deviation: in the capacitive-touch block the two TSC group-2 IO nets (NET0010 / PB5 and NET0017 / PB7) are tied together at the electrode node, with the 22 nF sampling capacitor on that same node, whereas the specification requires PB5 to reach the electrode through the 1 kΩ series resistor and PB7 to carry only the 22 nF cap to GND.
